svg.title: GrandPrixPassport build model — why GitHub comes before code
svg.desc: Diagram showing the full development workflow from MacBook to production, with GitHub as the central hub connecting all layers

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What tools does Sandeep use on his MacBook to write code?')
sendPrompt('Why do we need GitHub in the build process?')
sendPrompt('What runs in the dev environment?')
sendPrompt('What is staging environment used for?')
sendPrompt('What is in the production environment?')
sendPrompt('What does the CDN layer do in GrandPrixPassport?')
g.text: CloudFront + Route 53 + WAF + ACM SSL → grandprixpassport.com

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the frontend layer contain?')
g.text: Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind → Web App + PWA

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the API layer do?')
g.text: API Gateway + Lambda Functions → tickets, trips, alerts, users, support

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the AI layer work in GrandPrixPassport?')
g.text: Claude API → Trip Planner + Support Agent + Content Writer + 9 more agents

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What databases and data sources does GrandPrixPassport use?')
g.text: DynamoDB + Aurora + Redis + S3 + EventBridge (ticket price pipeline)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What security and auth does GrandPrixPassport use?')
g.text: Cognito + Secrets Manager + KMS + IAM (env-scoped) + VPC security groups

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is GrandPrixPassport monitored and audited?')
g.text: CloudWatch + X-Ray + CloudTrail + GuardDuty + PostHog + Cost Explorer

svg.text: Tap any layer to ask about it
